protocol: AI-assisted review of 62 source-separated development windows. Original labels and model scores hidden in pages; judgments frozen before opening private mapping. Some scenes previously seen. Not independent human gold.
policy: Active directed punching/kicking/grappling/throwing, including safe staged simulations. Not proximity, argument, separation/restraint alone, solo movement or passive aftermath.
